{{Quote|There are two hundred missiles in the Shadow Arsenal; only takes one to destroy Kaas City. Threat alone should make the Sith surrender. [&hellip;] Each one has a cloaking device, a short-range hyperdrive and a warhead with a kick. The ultimate first strike weapon.|Ardun Kothe|<ref name="TORC">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Shadow Arsenal}}</ref>}}
The '''Shadow Arsenal''' was the term given to a large quantity of [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]] developed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by the end of the [[Great Galactic War]]. It was orchestrated by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Laren Omas]] of [[Republic Special Forces Division]] who was involved with weapon research projects and brought together some of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] greatest scientists who were led by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nasan Godera]]. Their mission was to create warheads designed to bring about complete destruction to the restored [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TORC" />

While Dr. Godera was skeptical, Colonel Omas was successful in the creation of a stockpile of interplanetary missiles that were each equipped with a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] and had continent shaking power. It was hoped that the Arsenal would become the ultimate deterrent for further warfare and that it was a weapon too powerful to ignore or defend against. However, the development team began to fall apart during work on the project and Colonel Omas's death at [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] led to the program being shut down after each of the scientists went their separate ways. Dr Godera, however, continued to secretly build the Arsenal on [[Quesh]] until he realized the destructive power of the finished product.<ref name="TORC" />

The completed weapons proved to be an indiscriminate and catastrophic weapon capable of killing millions of civilians in addition to its intended target. This proved to Dr Godera that he had gone too far on this project and he abandoned the Shadow Arsenal on Quesh. The results of the program led to Dr Godera changing his weapon development methodology as he intended to build future devices intended for either [[Planet Prison|imprisonment]], [[Power Guard Enhancement System|guarding]] or [[Death Mark laser|selectively targeting]] enemies.<ref name="TORC" />

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Ardun Kothe]] used resources and agents of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] to locate the Shadow Arsenal. This led to the induction of a seemingly defecting [[Cipher Nine]] and the use of this [[Imperial Agent]] to recover the lost weapon codes from Colonel Omas's [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] on Hoth. Once recovered, Kothe intended to bring a fatal blow against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire by using the warheads to destroy [[Kaas City]] and end the conflict with the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. However, Nine broke the brainwashing program with the aid of [[Watcher X]] and killed Kothe's team. But before the agent could secure the arsenal for the Empire, [[Hunter (Star Cabal)|Hunter]], another member of Kothe's team and secretly working for the [[Star Cabal]], called in an Imperial bombing run, preventing the arsenal from falling into either galactic power's hands.
